hypotheses.Q0_symmetric_tensor_matches_projected_na: The full contracted symmetric tensor matches direct native-channel execution after identical input/output projection to relative error at most 1e-5.
hypotheses.Q1_rank64_input_output_quotient_is_suffi: The full 64x64 symmetric tensor retains at least 0.90 of every endpoint path effect on every corpus.
hypotheses.Q2_sixteen_tensor_modes_are_useful: Sixteen shared tensor modes retain at least 0.80 of every endpoint on every corpus.
hypotheses.Q3_thirtytwo_tensor_modes_are_sufficient: Thirty-two shared tensor modes retain at least 0.90 of every endpoint on every corpus.
hypotheses.Q4_symmetric_tensor_has_energy_rank32: The contracted output-to-quadratic tensor has energy R90 at most 32.
hypotheses.Q5_symmetric_tensor_transfers_ood: For every endpoint, rank-32 OOD fidelity is within 0.10 of FineWeb.
hypotheses.Q6_tensor_modes_beat_native_margin_chann: Thirty-two tensor modes exceed the prior 512-native-channel margin fidelity by at least 0.10 on every corpus.
